- Sleep duration was relatively stable, with an average of about 454 minutes (7.57 hours).
- Most days fell between 450 and 460 minutes; a slight increase occurred around March 14–16 (peak 465 minutes on March 15), and a noticeable dip to 440 minutes on March 20.
- Weekend days tended to show slightly higher durations, but the difference was small.
- No clear long-term upward or downward trend was evident; the pattern is stationary with periodic mild fluctuations.
